text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О's acknowledgement of
Doto
inspires her in the race. She goes
full throttle and
secures a win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Watching from the sidelines, Air Shakur
asserts
that the two have reached their
full
potential—but Opera O's total stats
still outweigh
Doto's, and neither
compare to the previous
generation's
powerhouses.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Is there really a ceiling cap to their
skills? If so,
can it be shattered? We
head for the autumn
Tenno Sho,
weighed down with anxiety.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
